text:
emily: quick follow-up from last night's DR postmortem. main recurring patterns: route flaps during node churn, backups missing post-restore validation, and deploys during autoscale. collecting owners here. react with :hand: to claim.

noah: i'll take routing validation and add a pre-scale sanity check. will prototype health probe and rollback gating this week.

sree: i'll own backups/restore verification. plan: automated checksum sampler + sample query set. target PR in 4 days.

alyssa: ops note 1: added 'validate route state' step to the restore runbook (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr). needs SME review.

ops-bot: created tickets: TKT-9001 (route-sanity), TKT-9002 (restore-verifier), TKT-9003 (deploy-freeze-rfc).

emily: proposed timeline: sree PR in 4d -> noah prototype in 6d -> alyssa review in 48h after PRs -> schedule scoped routing game-day after prototype. volunteers to run first restore drill?

sree: i will run the first restore drill in staging and invite platform + db. propose Tue 09:00 UTC next week (90m).

noah: provisional game-day slot next Thu 14:00 UTC (2h) for simulated control-plane isolation and routing failover checks.

emily: acceptance criteria suggestions: checksum match >=99.9% on sampled keys AND fallback traffic shift <60s. i'll add these to the tracker.

alyssa: noted. i'll review sree's PR and add hash-compare snippet.

emily: i'll create the remediation tracker, assign tickets to owners, and post a one-pager to #incidents when done. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
